{{Quote|The Archives. The library. The first hall&mdash;history of the Republic, chronicles of the Jedi going back over thousands of years. Their protector&mdash;Master ''Jocasta Nu''.|[[Sha Koon]]|<ref name="Seconds to Die">''[[Purge – Seconds to Die]]''</ref>}}
'''Jocasta Nu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and who tended to show overconfidence in the completeness of her Archives. Her patterned robes bore a traditional [[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata pattern]], representing her devotion to knowledge and learning.<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During her career, Nu served as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and trained many [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], including the future [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]; [[Olee Starstone]], whom she tutored in the years prior to the Clone Wars; and [[Jin-Lo Rayce]], founder of the [[Agents of Ossus]]. Jocasta Nu died when the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|ransacked]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is more knowledge here than anywhere else in the galaxy.|Jocasta Nu, on the Jedi Archives|<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
[[File:KaiArchives.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Jocasta Nu with [[Kai Justiss]]]]
Brought into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it is likely Jocasta Nu was discovered by a [[Jedi recruiter|recruiter]] of the [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]] to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] around infancy before being brought to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. Raised in a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngling]] [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]], she passed the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|trials]] of the [[Jedi academy]] and was eventually selected by a Master for one-on-one training. Passing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], Nu pursued the path of the [[Jedi Consular|Consular]] and became a [[Jedi Researcher|researcher]] specializing in the field of [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeology]]. Attaching herself to the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] after consulting the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]], Nu traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] gathering information for the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. During her journeys, Nu discovered the Force-sensitive [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]], [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], and delivered him to the Temple for entrance into the academy there. Eventually Nu returned to the Temple and selected Jerec as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], passing along her own desires to learn all there was to know in the galaxy, which eventually drove him to Knighthood himself. After her padawan completed his training, Nu was made a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and began to perform the duties of an [[Lore Keeper|archivist]] in the Archives. Eventually, Nu was appointed Chief Librarian of the Archives and [[Jedi Archives|Library]] and made a member of the [[Librarian's Assembly]].<ref name="db" /> Part of her responsibility as Chief Librarian was oversight of the [[Educational Corps]]; she reported directly to the Reassignment Council on all matters concerning this branch of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

During her tenure as Chief Librarian, Nu was appointed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in [[62 BBY/Legends|62 BBY]], serving on the august body before stepping down [[52 BBY/Legends|ten years later]]. Foregoing the traditional [[Jedi apparel/Legends|brown robes]] of the Order, Nu began wearing a tunic and dress imprinted with a traditional [[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata pattern]]. Over the years, Nu came to know most of the Jedi in the Temple, becoming especially fond of Master [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]; she personally mourned the loss of his great idealism when he left the Order shortly following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Using the extensive knowledge gained in the field with the ExplorCorps, Nu continued to gather a very precise and extensive knowledge of the galaxy.<ref name="db" /> Working in cooperation with the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]], Nu was always advised of upcoming missions so that she could help prep a report for all Jedi about to depart the Temple.<ref name="TOW">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Only Witness]]''</ref>

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Nu undertook a diplomatic mission to the world of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] with Jedi Masters Dooku, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]. At the meeting, the Jedi team met [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], in reality the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Plagueis.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Nu took on her last [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jin-Lo Rayce]]<ref name="TFU CG" /> sometime after the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] of [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> teaching him all of the secret passage ways in and out of the Temple.<ref name="TFU CG" /> In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent on a mission to [[Vorzyd IV]]. Nu provided the two Jedi with the information needed for them to complete their assignment.<ref name="The Threat Within">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Threat Within]]''</ref>

Over the course of her time as director of the Archives her confidence in the data stored in the stacks was whole; claiming that if something was not in the Archives, then it did not exist. This statement was belied when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Obi-Wan Kenobi was unable to find the aquatic world [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in the Archives and suggested that the Archives were incomplete; somewhat miffed, Madame Nu reiterated her belief that if an item was not in the Archives, it did not exist, and strode away to assist a young Padawan who had just arrived.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:JocastaAhsoka-HH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jocasta Nu familiarizes Ahsoka Tano with the Archives.]]
With the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] underway in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the High Council became increasingly concerned with protecting the Archives as more and more Jedi were called away from Coruscant to fight on the front lines. As reprimand for failing to follow orders during the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], the High Council assigned Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Temple Security Force|guard duty]] within the Archives. Meeting Tano in the Archives' Rotunda, Nu familiarized the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] with security protocols in the Archives and around the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vaults]]. Putting Tano to the test, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] had sent [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] into the Temple to assist in his infiltration mission. As a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]], Parasitti was able to slip pass both Tano and Nu under the guise of the recently deceased Master [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]]. Suspicious of Enisence's oddly curt behavior, Nu offered the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] a gentle hand, only to be struck by the bounty hunter and rendered unconscious. Stealing Nu's identity, as well as her blue-bladed lightsaber, Parasitti broke through Temple security and allowed Bane to enter the Temple without much trouble. While distracting the Jedi monitoring Temple security, Parasitti was discovered by Tano to be an impostor. After a brief scuffle, Parasitti was defeated and placed under arrest, yet Bane had already successfully completed his mission to infiltrate the Vaults and escape unnoticed. Nu recovered shortly after and returned immediately to her work.<ref name="HH" />

Nu also played a pivotal role in other [[Jedi investigator/Legends|Jedi detectives's]] investigations as they utilized Nu and the vast array of research material in the Temple's Archives, as an important resource during their investigation.<ref name="RussoSWE">{{SWE|characters|russo-isc|Russo-ISC}}</ref>

===Order 66 and death===
{{Quote|I want access to the Temple's signal beacon.''"<br />"''On whose authority?''"<br />"''By order of the Supreme Chancellor.''"<br />"''That is not within the Chancellor's power. Only the Jedi Council can authorize access.|Darth Vader and Jocasta Nu, before her death|<ref name="ROTS VG">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>|audio=JocastaAndAnakin.flac}}
Nu remained at the Temple throughout the conflict with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], one of the highest ranking Masters to remain constantly on Coruscant. At the end of the war, she was diligently at work in the Archives when [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] was initiated in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Shortly prior, she finally expressed doubt to Knight [[Sha Koon]] in the completeness of her Archives. As fighting erupted in the Temple's lower levels, Nu summoned her Padawan, Rayce, to the Archives and handed him several [[Datachip/Legends|datachips]] with information from the Stacks uploaded to them. Ordering him to flee, she watched as Rayce departed the Temple through the secret passageways she had detailed to him over his apprenticeship.<ref name="TFU CG" /><ref name="Seconds to Die" />
[[File:JocastaNuDeathSTD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jocasta Nu is [[Shiak|impaled]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]]]
Remaining behind, Nu waited in the Archives until [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] marched through the great wooden doors flanked by several [[clone assassin]]s. Vader demanded that Nu unlock the secured [[Jedi beacon/Legends|Temple beacon]] by saying that the Supreme Chancellor had given such order, a demand Nu firmly denied by igniting her blue lightsaber, stating that access to the Jedi Temple's signal beacon wasn't within Chancellor Palpatine's power but within the Jedi Council's. Offended, Vader casually [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Grip|lifted]] the esteemed Jedi with the Force and impaled her through the chest with his own saber, killing Nu instantly before Vader carelessly flung her body amongst the Stacks.<ref name="ROTS VG" /> Ironically, during her conversation with Koon earlier that day, Nu had praised Skywalker as a hero.<ref name="Seconds to Die" />

===Legacy===
Immediately after her death, Nu's loyal librarians attempted to stop Skywalker and destroy all of the knowledge stored there so that it would not fall into the hands of their mortal enemies, but they were all killed and the Sith continued to ransack the Archives. After the fighting died down, Nu's lifeless body was discovered by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Master Kenobi as they [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrated]] the occupied temple.<ref name="ROTS VG" /> Her body would eventually be gathered up and her name checked off against Archives records of all active Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> The bodies of Jedi were gathered by the clones and burned on a pyre on the Temple entrance.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown]]''</ref>

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] emerged from the ashes of the Republic, [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] compiled a statement that was to be issued to the citizens of the Empire as proof of the Jedi's crimes. In his fabricated report, Pestage stated that Jocasta Nu was executed for harboring information that threatened the Empire and its citizens.<ref name="Order 66: Destroy All Jedi">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If an item does not appear in our records, it does not exist.|Jocasta Nu|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Jocasta.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Jedi Master Jocasta Nu]]
By the time of the Clone Wars, Nu was thin, frail-looking woman with long silver [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that she wore in a tight bun.<ref name="AOCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> She had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a pronounced scar running along the right side of her face.<ref name="db" /> Despite her wispy appearance, Nu actually was a known firebrand among her peers, noted for her immense determination and strength. Despite this, younger Jedi students still attempted to push her around, trying to get the librarian to do the bulk of their research for them.<ref name="AOCn" /> However, Nu considered the Jedi Archives a tool rather than a service, and she expected all Jedi to do their research by themselves, which led her to being particularly strict toward those students.<ref name="AOCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

If Jocasta Nu had allowed herself to have an attachment it would have been to her library. She had a trait for being a little overconfident about the amount of information in the Archives and often got affronted if someone suggested that the Stacks were incomplete. This trait was shown when Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] noted the supposed disappearance of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. To this she indignantly replied that if something didn't appear in her records it didn't exist.<ref name="AOTC" /> However, by the end of the Clone Wars, Jocasta Nu came to accept the fact that her Archives did not contain everything.<ref name="Seconds to Die" /> Although a little too proud of the Archives, Nu was friendly and helpful, but most people knew better than to get on the wrong side of her.<ref name="db" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:JocastaNu-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|180px|Nu was still skilled with her lightsaber]]
{{Quote|You may have Madame Jocasta's shape, but not her skills.|Ahsoka Tano, to Cato Parasitti|audio=NotHerSkills-HH.flac|<ref name="HH" />}}
Achieving all of the basic [[Force power/Legends|Force skills]] at the academy during her younger years, Nu had pursued the studies of the Consular, perfecting her researching skills through her studies as an archaeologist of the ExplorCorps. While retired from combat missions in her later years, she still wore her lightsaber proudly as a reminder of her active years, during which she had received a thin vertical scar along her cheek. When ignited her saber would emit a shimmering blue blade, which was somewhat unusual as Jedi Consulars typically carried green-bladed lightsabers, used sparingly but with skill.<ref name="db" />

==Equipment==
During the course of her career, Jocasta Nu wielded at least two different lightsabers, one of which had a green blade,<ref name="FF41">{{FactFile|41|JOC 1-2|Madame Jocasta Nu}}</ref> and another with a blue blade.<ref name="HH" /> In her late years, she wore robes inscribed with a traditional Ansata pattern, which symbolized her love of knowledge and learning.<ref name="FF41" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Jocasta Nu first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], where she was played by [[Alethea McGrath]],<ref name="AOC">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]</ref> an actress who also voiced her in the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]], in which she is killed in a cut-scene by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ROTS VG" /> Jocasta Nu is voiced by [[Flo Di Re]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars TV series'']].<ref name="db" /> 

While the original [[Databank (original)|Databank]] hosted on [[StarWars.com]] gave her height as 1.67 meters,<ref name="db" /> the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 41|forty-first issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' stated that she was 1.60 meters tall.<ref name="FF41" />

In an interview, her actress Alethea McGrath indicated that a lot of Nu's scenes and backstory were cut before filming and during editing, including that she and Count Dooku used to be in love.<ref name="Appearing Knightley">{{InsiderCite|75|Appearing Knightley (and the Women of Star Wars)|Appearing Knightley (and the Women of ''Star Wars'')}}</ref>
